messages:
elena: Quick coordination — we have three interview slots for the SRE infra hire on Thu. Need a panelist cover for the 11:00 PT slot and someone to own the debrief. Also confirm which rubric variant we should use (we switched last sprint).
elena: schedule snippet:
```
Thu — panels
- 11:00 PT — Panel (3 interviewers)
- 12:30 PT — Panel (on-call focus)
Debrief window: 13:15-14:00 PT
```
elena: Ask: who can take the 11:00 panel and lead the debrief? who can scribe? we'll use the compact rubric but want to confirm weightings.
samir: I can be on the 11:00 panel, happy to score but juggling another call — can't lead the debrief. I can stay for notes if needed.
priya: I can scribe and capture the debrief doc + ASR link. will you share the rubric link? :+1:
alex: I'm booked 11-12. Can join the 12:30 panel though. If someone can swap with me for the later slot we can cover both.
rafael: I can take 11:00 panel and lead the debrief if that helps. prefer taking audio notes (I'll drop summary bullets). :thumbsup:
people-ops-bot: Reminder: candidate consent form (SRE-117) is pending. Please ensure candidate has approved recording before interview. https://people-ops/redwood/consent
elena: Perfect — @rafael takes panel + debrief lead, @priya scribe. Quick rubric clarification: we moved to "compact" rubric v2.1 (link below). Adjusted weights: system design 30%, debugging 25%, behavioral 25%, on-call/ops 20%. When writing debrief, include 2 anchors (strong / weak) and one concrete example behavior.
elena: rubric link: https://wiki.redwood.xyz/rubrics/compact-v2.1
samir: ack. small note: for on-call scoring, use the scenario prompt in the second tab — we had a mismatch last time where folks used a different prompt set.
priya: noted. I'll paste the prompt into the debrief doc beforehand.
alex: I'll review PR #4820 (candidate takehome diff) and leave a couple of quick comments by 10:30 PT so panel has context.
rafael: thanks. I prefer if someone flags any major style or security concerns before the panel. I'll handle the scoring sheet and post results in the hiring channel.
interview-bot: Calendar invite created and shared with panelists. Recording consent checkbox added to invite (candidate-facing).
Invite: https://calendar.redwood/evt/98321
elena: Final checklist:
- rafael: panel lead + debrief owner
- priya: scribe + ASR/link capture
- alex: PR review by 10:30 PT
- samir: panelist + scoring
- people-ops: confirm consent and post final invite with dial-in
I'll update the calendar with the debrief doc link and post a brief pre-interview note in #hiring. Thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
